text.en:
Section 4 of Article II of Presidential Decree No. 1468, as amended by Executive Order No. 1055, is
hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 4. Governing Board. The corporate powers and duties of the Authority shall be vested on and exercised
by a Governing Board of seven (7) members to be appointed by the President."

All laws, decrees, orders, proclamations, rules, regulations, and issuances, or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with any provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-seven.
